page.overview:
Who is Siann, Mika and Sora?

The three, originally lifeless corpses that were part of the Netherrealm, were loyal servants to Quan Chi who used his powers of sorcery to allow them to have a living form. Beautiful women and skilled fighters, the three were master manipulators and expert assassins. Despite their loyalty, however, Quan Chi often mistreated the three and threatened to return them to their previous states if they failed or betrayed him, but thus far he has never made good on this threat with the implication that he wants to keep the girls alive and well.

Siann appeared to be the most ruthless and rebellious of the three, relishing the thrill of assassination. Mika assumed a leadership role, attempting to direct the group’s actions while maintaining a forceful relationship with Quan Chi in an effort to convince him not to annihilate them. Sora, meanwhile, was the most fearful member of the trio, constantly plagued by doubt and hesitation.

The three assassins make their debut in this episode. On his way back to the trading post, Kung Lao is approached by a woman claiming that a group of ruffians is tormenting a townswoman. He follows her to the alleged perpetrators, who mock him before murdering the innocent woman. The stranger who led him there is revealed to be Sora, who had lured him into a trap. A fight breaks out, during which Siann nearly kills Kung Lao with her blade. He is narrowly saved by Taja and Siro, forcing the trio of assassins to retreat.

Later, the women are reprimanded by their master, Quan Chi, in his palace for fleeing instead of completing their mission. Despite his anger, Quan Chi spares them and sends them out again with a new objective. He brews a potion capable of unlocking a person’s deepest, uncontrollable desires and driving them into madness. Disguised under false identities, the women deceive Kung Lao, Taja, and Siro, eventually injecting the potion into their bloodstream through trickery.
